notes: Historical national hourly-earnings observations from Iraq LFS 2021, implemented by CSO and KRSO with ILO support. These employee-earnings benchmarks are not current employer charge-out rates and are not inflation-adjusted or used in 2025/2026 cost estimates.

iraq.ilo-cso-krso.lfs-2021.publisher: International Labour Organization, Central Statistical Organization, and Kurdistan Region Statistics Office
iraq.ilo-cso-krso.lfs-2021.access: Iraq Labour Force Survey 2021, Annex C Table T14 (PDF page 105) reports national average hourly earnings in the main job for employees by ISCO occupational group. Transcribed rates: craft and related trades IQD 2,222/h; plant and machine operators/assemblers IQD 2,685/h; technicians and associate professionals IQD 4,279/h; professionals IQD 5,861/h. Survey year is 2021; no inflation, employer burden, benefits, overtime or employer charge-out conversion is applied. These are historical context only and must not be substituted for 2025/2026 regional wage observations.
